#LinkedIn replaced Argo CD with a custom GitOps engine to handle 100,000+ weekly deployments across 250+ Kubernetes clusters.

By moving to stateless, per-deployment pods, they cut deployment infra failures from 925 down to 63.

🔗 Deep dive: https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/11/kubernetes-argocd-linkedin/
